display.title: Botania: The Manasteel Age
display.subtitle: Smelt mana into metal
description: Drop iron into a charged §aMana Pool§r and it transmutes into §bManasteel§r —
Botania's first magical metal, the stock for tools, armour, and the apparatus
that follows. Build a working stock of it.
§7Manasteel is the Magic lane's iron: the foundation everything else is built on.
